name: governed-agentic-dev-framework
description: Governed Agentic Development Framework — repository root (private; never published). The OSS CLI is @svayam-opensource/gov at publish/actions/ts; framework content ships from publish/content; the frozen legacy bash CLI is archived under publish/actions/deprecated.
_comment_devDependencies: js-yaml parses agent/harness-manifest.yaml; tsx lets render-harness.mjs import the renderer straight out of publish/actions/ts/src so the publisher runs the SAME code an adopter's `gov rules build` runs. tsx WAS present only because packages/* happen to depend on it, and `render-harness:check` is now a required PR gate (.github/workflows/node-ci.yml) — a gate whose tool no manifest declares is a gate that disappears the day a workspace is dropped, with nothing failing. Pinned exactly to the version already in package-lock.json so declaring it re-resolved nothing.
